reviewers.recommended_background: requirements engineering or the scenario business domain

criteria: correct functional, non-functional, business-rule, or constraint category
no semantic duplicate inside the same scenario
gate and reveal condition do not expose hidden knowledge too early
adjudication: Any disagreement is resolved by a third reviewer. Preserve both independent forms and the adjudication record as run evidence.
approval_rule: A CSV row may become approved only after two matching approvals or documented third-reviewer adjudication.
provenance_rule: Synthetic fixtures must remain labelled synthetic and must not be described as observations from real users.
